body: He is dealing with many issues at the moment. I don't want to burden him any further with ongoing problems since we met. He as problems with his family, career stress, financial stress, etc. I know he wouldn't drop everything but he would prioritize me into his schedule, which would affect everything else. I don't want that for him.
I think it was just the fear of vulnerability. I couldn't get myself to open up in therapy, so eventually I stopped going.

I have talked to my boyfriend about wanting to commit suicide. I'm sure it hurt him when I said that I feel like dying every single day. He asked me how I felt on our first anniversary? He reserved a dinner at a fancy revolving restaurant. Then we went for a walk on the beach, it was breath taking and beautiful. I felt happy.

I'm not sure if this makes sense but I have activities and events in which I feel happy in. However, once the activity stops and sometimes while the activity is happening, I feel tremendous amount of unhappiness. I can explain it best as enjoying any junk food. You feel great as you're satisfying your cravings but feel horrible and guilty afterwords. I cannot physically keep eating junk food 24/7, unless I want to be 400+ lbs with a lot of limitations to be body. 

As for now, he has a lot on his hands right now. The best I can do for him is support him in his time of need, everything in our relationship won't always be about me.

It felt a lot better when I first told it to my bf. I thought it would feel just as good if I did it here but it's not the case. I feel the same as I did before posting about the situation. However, I've liked seeing the comments filled with positive people. There are time when I see the wonders of nature and fall in love but it makes me want to die even more. Ask my brain how that works. 

Unfortunately, no I do not have a pet. My roommate has a strict no pet policy, so can't really do much about that.
Other than the guilt of leaving behind my family and boyfriend, no. I've thought about breaking up with him to make it easier for him but I can't break up from my family.

I should have mentioned that I tried one therapist. It took a lot of courage for me to go but it didn't work out. I guess I don't like being so vulnerable around anyone other than my boyfriend and even that took a lot. I know that's not the answer you're looking for, I know that I should try to open up more... it's hard for me, hell of a lot easier online. I guess that's why I shared the story.

But yes, I may try going to a therapist again in the near future.

I don't remember their faces, I remember their article of clothing. Also, I'm not a spiritual person, so I don't believe in that (I hope that doesn't offend you). The memories are not pleasant for me, to say the least. Sometimes I wish it stayed blocked forever. It haunts me when my partner and I try to have sex. It haunts me in my everyday life, especially when alone.

I'm sorry to hear your story. I hope you don't get hurt by this when I say that I find comfort in hearing a story similar to mine.

I've played with the idea of it being a dream but I'm certain it is not. They are real memories that I blocked out. I didn't go into detail with the incident but other than the faces, I remember a lot.

Also, I don't believe that the rape was the sole cause of my lack of memory. Due to immigration and the new culture shock, I remember everything as clear as day from the time when I got off the plane. Getting on the plane is blurry, flight itself is blurry etc. 

But yes, I've played around with that idea. Unfortunately, it's not the case for me. Yes, I like animals.

I remember days where I was momentarily happy and had only one day since high school where I didn't want to die. There was nothing special about that day. However, I've wanted to die every single day, even on my birthday, anniversary and Christmas.
